program:
PARAMS = {
    "g1":  (15.0, 8.0, 22.0),        # gm/Id of CS gain device M1 (biased by IREF)
    "L1":  (0.5, 0.25, 1.0),         # L of M1 / M3 (mirror pair)
    "gsf": (18.0, 10.0, 24.0),       # gm/Id of source follower
    "Lsf": (0.15, 0.15, 0.5),        # L of follower
    "Isf": (10e-6, 3e-6, 14e-6),     # follower bias current
    "Rf":  (470e3, 420e3, 700e3),    # feedback resistor
    "Cf":  (4e-15, 0.5e-15, 15e-15), # feedback capacitor (damping)
    "fu":  (1.2e9, 0.3e9, 4e9),      # target unity-gain freq of CS stage gm1/(2*pi*Cx)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cpd = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13); cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    Rf, Cf = p["Rf"], p["Cf"]

    # bias point (iterate node voltages)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["g1"], p["L1"], iref, vds=1.2)
    vg = m1.vgs                                      # vout_dc = vg (no DC current in Rf)
    msf = lut.size("n", p["gsf"], p["Lsf"], p["Isf"], vds=vdd - vg, vsb=vg)
    vx = vg + msf.vgs
    for _ in range(2):
        m1 = lut.size("n", p["g1"], p["L1"], iref, vds=vx)
        vg = m1.vgs
        msf = lut.size("n", p["gsf"], p["Lsf"], p["Isf"], vds=vdd - vg, vsb=vg)
        vx = vg + msf.vgs
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["g1"], p["L1"], p["Isf"], vds=vg)   # follower sink, gate on iin node

    # set CS-stage unity-gain frequency with Cc at node X
    cgs_sf = max(msf.cgg - msf.cgd, 0.0)
    cx_par = m1.cdd + msf.cgd + 0.2 * cgs_sf
    cx_need = m1.gm / (2 * PI * p["fu"])
    Cc = cx_need - cx_par
    use_cc = Cc >= 0.2e-15

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M1", "ibias", "iin", "vss", "vss", m1)        # CS gain stage, IREF is its load
    n.dev("M2", "vdd", "ibias", "vout", "vss", msf)      # source follower (in loop)
    n.dev("M3", "vout", "iin", "vss", "vss", m3)         # follower current sink (mirror of M1)
    n.R("RF", "vout", "iin", Rf)
    n.C("CF", "vout", "iin", Cf)
    if use_cc:
        n.C("CC", "ibias", "vss", Cc)

    # small-signal prediction: 3-node nodal solve (iin, X, vout)
    Cx = cx_par + (Cc if use_cc else 0.0)
    cin = cpd + m1.cgg + m3.cgg - m1.cgd - m3.cgd
    cgd1, cgd3 = m1.cgd, m3.cgd
    gmb = msf.gmbs
    gout = msf.gds + m3.gds
    cout = cl + m3.cdd
    f = np.logspace(3, 10, 700)
    zt = []
    for fi in f:
        s = 2j * PI * fi
        Yf = 1.0 / Rf + s * Cf
        Y = np.array([
            [s * cin + Yf + s * cgd1 + s * cgd3, -s * cgd1, -Yf - s * cgd3],
            [m1.gm - s * cgd1, m1.gds + s * Cx + s * cgd1 + s * cgs_sf, -s * cgs_sf],
            [m3.gm - Yf - s * cgd3, -msf.gm - s * cgs_sf,
             msf.gm + gmb + gout + s * cout + Yf + s * cgs_sf + s * cgd3],
        ], dtype=complex)
        v = np.linalg.solve(Y, np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0], dtype=complex))
        zt.append(abs(v[2]))
    zt = np.array(zt)
    z0 = zt[0]
    below = np.where(zt < z0 / math.sqrt(2))[0]
    f3db = float(f[below[0]]) if len(below) else float(f[-1])

    kT4 = 4 * 1.380649e-23 * 300.15
    noise = math.sqrt(kT4 / Rf) * 1.05

    return n, {
        "zt_dbohm": db(z0),
        "f3db": f3db,
        "in_noise_1m": noise,
        "power": vdd * (iref + p["Isf"]),
        "vout_dc": vg,
    }
